pages.title: A boiling water reactor and the plant around it
text: Realistic BWR adds a boiling water reactor to Minecraft, with the plant around it: pumps, steam lines, turbines, a condenser, cooling, emergency cooling, containment and a grid connection.
Power emerges from neutronics. You move control rods and change recirculation flow, and the core decides what it does. There is no commanded burn rate.

pages.title: You are the protection
text: Nothing in the plant acts on your behalf. There are no automatic scrams, no automatic emergency cooling starts, no automatic valve closures and no built-in trips. A pump runs because you started it. A valve moves because you moved it.
Protection is what you build and wire: panel switches, relief valves, emergency cooling pumps, or CC:Tweaked programs you write. Until you add it the plant has none, and a mistake can melt the core.

pages.title: What you need, and where to start
text: Minecraft 1.21.1 with NeoForge. Mekanism and CC:Tweaked are optional and installed separately. Mekanism supplies steel, uranium and pipes that connect to the plant's ports, and with it installed the recipes use its materials; CC:Tweaked gives Lua control of nearly every machine.
This is an early alpha: expect rough edges, and back up your worlds before updating.
Chapter 2 builds a first plant and chapter 3 its control room. Chapter 4 is fuel, 5 the safety systems, 6 what happens when they fail, 7 computers and 8 the server options.
